Tests the British cutover chronology and date implementation.

The fixtures deliberately cover dates before, during, and after the 1752 British Julian-to-Gregorian cutover, including the skipped September dates that are leniently interpreted by the implementation.
Start of the supported British chronology and its ISO offset.
Julian leap-year behavior before the Gregorian cutover.
Britain remains Julian at the 1582 Gregorian reform used elsewhere.
British cutover period: 1752-09-02 is followed by 1752-09-14.
Modern dates use the same date fields as ISO.
Invalid month/day combinations around regular and leap-year February.
